name: Tantalus Systems Holding Inc.
summary: Tantalus Systems Holding Inc. is a smart grid technology provider based in Burnaby, Canada, serving utilities in North America and the Caribbean. Its solutions aim to make electrical distribution grids more reliable, efficient and intelligent. One core product, the TRUEdge Communication Module, is a Linux-based platform that links meters, sensors and switches for secure, real-time two-way data exchange.
